purpose: Fourth bounded internet verification group for five previously unaudited batch-51 candidates while the same V53 browser-acceptance task remains unclaimed. This audit also records one material guarantor-risk amendment to prior row 507. No second runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_route_policy: Only first-party operator sites, NHS/GOV.UK records, Companies House records and local-authority pages count as verified. A verified route may establish a conflict without proving exact occupation, lease continuation or legal completion.
method.historical_status_policy: Sold, Sold Prior, Withdrawn Post and auction descriptions remain historical source statements and are not promoted to current availability or legal completion.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical parcel geometry is read.

rows.address: Idlewells Shopping Centre, Market Street, Sutton-in-Ashfield, Nottinghamshire, NG17 1BP
verified_facts: Acuitus records Withdrawn Post status, a long-leasehold shopping centre, approximately 150,025 square feet, around 250 parking spaces and estimated net operating income of GBP 542,325.
The current first-party Idlewells site identifies the operating shopping centre at Market Street, Sutton-in-Ashfield, NG17 1BP and presents a current retailer directory.
Ashfield District Council provides a live official planning-application search route.
